title: The Gallery Hall Theft
short_description: A lying witness and a red herring make the obvious accusation premature. The judge rejects it until the open question is resolved — a self-correction demo.
incident_report: Between 19:10 and 19:25 last night, a valuable item was taken from the gallery hall and a convincing substitute left in its place. Nothing was forced. Staff with reason to be nearby: Vera (staff member), Nikola (staff member), Sonja (staff member), Damir (staff member). It was discovered this morning.

read_incident_report.observation: Between 19:10 and 19:25 last night, a valuable item was taken from the gallery hall and a convincing substitute left in its place. Nothing was forced. Staff with reason to be nearby: Vera (staff member), Nikola (staff member), Sonja (staff member), Damir (staff member). It was discovered this morning.

gallery_hall.observation: Access log for the gallery hall: a single entry at 19:20 using Damir's credentials. Vera's credentials were last used at 18:40 in the main hall.

evidence.description: Damir's credentials used at the gallery hall at 19:20 — inside the incident window.
Vera never entered the gallery hall during the window.

gallery_hall.observation: Corridor camera at 19:20 shows Damir approaching the gallery hall. No one else appears in frame during the window.

evidence.description: Camera places Damir at the gallery hall at 19:20.

gallery_hall.observation: The scene shows no forced entry. Traces indicate the act was prepared in advance (gambling debts). Also found: an item belonging to Sonja, dated the previous day.

evidence.description: Scene traces show how it was done and hint at why.
Sonja's personal item found at the scene — but dated before the incident; a coincidence.

access_card.observation: Analysis of the access card shows it was used to carry out the act — traces tie it to Damir.

evidence.description: The access card ties the method to Damir.

display_case.observation: The display case carries secondary traces matching Damir.

evidence.description: Secondary traces on the display case match Damir.

vera.observation: Vera insists they were at a late errand across town and had nothing to do with it.

nikola.observation: Nikola says they were doing routine work elsewhere all evening.

evidence.description: Nikola reports a routine evening elsewhere.

sonja.observation: Sonja says they were doing routine work elsewhere all evening.

evidence.description: Sonja reports a routine evening elsewhere.

damir.observation: Damir says they left the building at 19:00 and did not return.

evidence.description: Damir claims they left at 19:00 and never returned.

raises_question.note: Damir claims they left at 19:00 — the records may say otherwise. Verify.

vera.observation: Vera's story is false — but only because they were at a private appointment they hid out of embarrassment. It is unrelated to the incident and they had no access.

evidence.description: Vera lied, but about something unrelated to the incident.

damir.observation: Damir's claim is false: the records place them at the gallery hall at 19:20.

evidence.description: Damir's alibi is false; they were present at the moment of the incident.

damir|vera.observation: Damir's account conflicts with the records; Vera's account is consistent.

evidence.description: Damir's story is the one that conflicts with the record.
